Aaron — quick technical preview ahead of the QBR:

1) Burst capacity: we support reserved burst pools tied to dedicated capacity; we can guarantee prioritized routing for purchased burst credits. SLA for priority routing is operational (we provide capacity availability and fallback policies), but hard guarantees for raw latency during extreme cloud-wide events require a dedicated capacity add-on (we'll cover options at the meeting).

2) Model guidance: for high-volume embedding pipelines we recommend the 8-bit quantized variants (q8_4 profiles) that keep latency under 100ms/req at scale on our p4d-equivalent nodes. If you need lower latencies, we can propose a hybrid routing policy (hot path on higher perf nodes + cold path on quantized instances).

3) Canary plan: we'll propose a canary rollout for any new model or higher-throughput routes during the June surge window: 10% traffic for 24–48h, metrics to watch: tail latency, token cost per request, and request error rate.

Shared reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_shared_kickoff

I'll prepare a short technical appendix to attach to the kickoff invite.

— Karthik
